title: Timing Ergonomics v2
objective: Implement Sage/IPython-style %timeit with compile-once execution, warmup, calibrated loops, repeats, wall-time statistics, scope-preserving semantics, and bounded tests

handoff.summary: Adds Sage/IPython-style %timeit to Node REPL and embedded kernels without changing Python grammar. The host parses the directive and the body once in the active language mode, codegen emits one lexical inline loop around only the lowered statement, and shared timing hooks perform one warmup, optional power-of-ten calibration, repeated high-resolution wall samples, statistics, initialization reporting, and exception-safe abort. Tests cover -n/-r parsing, deterministic calibration, current-scope assignment/import behavior, result suppression, Python XOR semantics, lexical temporary isolation, and cooperative interruption with a reusable kernel.
risks: Automatic calibration deliberately targets about 200ms per sample and may make extremely fast expressions run for several seconds, matching the documented benchmarking tradeoff.
